cases.prompt: On NIFTY 5-minute bars, go long when the 9 EMA crosses above the 21 EMA. Exit when it crosses back below.
Reliance daily chart: buy when the 50-day SMA crosses above the 200-day SMA and sell when it crosses back under. This is positional, hold overnight.
BANKNIFTY 15 minute. Buy when the MACD line (12, 26, 9) crosses above the signal line while MACD is above zero. Exit when MACD crosses below the signal line.
On NIFTY 15-minute, buy when RSI(14) crosses back above 30. Exit when RSI is above 60. Stop loss 0.5%.
Nifty 5 min: enter long when the close crosses above the upper Bollinger Band (20, 2). Get out when the close crosses below the middle band.
BANKNIFTY 5-minute. Go long when the close crosses above the Supertrend (10, 3) line; exit when the close crosses below it.

NIFTY 5m: buy when the close is at or above the 20-bar Donchian upper channel and the 20-bar volume ratio is above 2. Exit when the close drops below the Donchian middle line. Stop at 2 times ATR(14), target 1.5%.
On BANKNIFTY 15-minute, buy when the 20 EMA is above the 50 EMA, ADX(14) is above 25 and +DI is above -DI. Exit when the 20 EMA goes below the 50 EMA.
Nifty 5-minute CPR strategy: go long when the close crosses above the top central pivot (TC) with volume above its 20-bar average. Exit if the close crosses below the pivot. Max 2 trades a day.
BANKNIFTY 5 min: buy when the close crosses above the previous day's high. Stop loss 100 points, target 200 points. One trade a day. No other exit.
Short NIFTY on the 5-minute chart when the close crosses below VWAP and RSI(14) is under 45. Cover when the close crosses back above VWAP.
Nifty 15m: buy when Stochastic %K (14, 3, 3) crosses above %D while %K is below 20. Exit when %K is above 80.
FINNIFTY 5-minute: go long when the close crosses above the Parabolic SAR (step 0.02, max 0.2), exit when the close crosses below it.
On SENSEX 15-minute bars buy when Williams %R(14) crosses above -80 and exit when it is above -20.
BANKNIFTY 5 min. Enter long when the 9 EMA crosses above the 50 SMA, RSI(14) is above 50 and RSI is rising. Exit when the 9 EMA crosses below the 50 SMA.
BankNifty 5-minute: when the 9 EMA crosses above the 50 SMA, sell the ATM put of the current monthly expiry. Exit when the 9 EMA crosses back below the 50 SMA. Stop loss 30% on the premium.
Sell an ATM straddle on NIFTY at 9:30 every day, current weekly expiry, with a 30% stop loss on each leg, and square off at 3:10 pm.
Buy an ATM straddle on BANKNIFTY (current weekly) when the Bollinger bandwidth (20, 2) on the 15-minute chart is below 0.006. Target 40% on each leg, stop 25% on each leg.
Nifty 15-minute: on a bullish 9/21 EMA crossover buy the ATM call and sell the call 2 strikes out of the money, both current weekly.
On NIFTY 15m when the 9 EMA crosses below the 21 EMA, buy the ATM put and sell the put two strikes out of the money, weekly expiry.

Nifty 5-minute iron condor when the Bollinger bandwidth (20, 2) is below 0.006: sell the call and the put 2 strikes OTM, buy the call and the put 4 strikes OTM, current weekly expiry, one trade a day.
Sell a BANKNIFTY strangle at 9:20: the call and the put 3 strikes OTM, next weekly expiry, 2 lots each. Stop loss 50% of premium per leg. Everything out by 3:00 pm.
BANKNIFTY 5-minute: when the close crosses above the previous day high, buy 1 lot of the ATM call (current weekly). Stop loss 20% of premium, target 40%. Max 2 trades per day.
Nifty 5 min: if the close crosses below the previous day's low, buy the put one strike in the money, current weekly. Use a 15% trailing stop on the premium, active from entry.
Reliance, daily bars, positional: when RSI(14) is above 55 buy the stock and sell a call 3 strikes OTM in the current monthly expiry. Exit both when RSI falls below 40.
Sell a 0.20 delta strangle on NIFTY (one call, one put, current weekly) at 9:45, square off at 15:15, at most one trade per day.
Sell the NIFTY 25000 call, current monthly expiry, whenever RSI(14) on the 15-minute chart is above 70. Stop loss 40% of premium.
NIFTY 5m, long on a 9/21 EMA bullish crossover. Stop loss 1.5 times ATR(14). Trail by 0.5% once the trade is 0.5% in profit. No signal exit.
BankNifty 5 min, buy when the 9 EMA crosses above the 21 EMA, exit on the reverse cross. Stop trading for the day after losing 5000 rupees or after making 10000. Maximum 3 trades a day.
Nifty 15m: buy when RSI(14) crosses above 30; exit when RSI is above 60. Allow re-entry up to 2 times a day, waiting 4 bars after an exit.
Trade the 9/21 EMA crossover long on NIFTY 5-minute, but only take entries between 9:45 and 14:30, and square everything off at 15:20. Exit on the opposite cross.

Swing trade HDFCBANK on daily candles: buy when the close crosses above the 20-day SMA with RSI(14) above 50; exit when the close crosses below the 20-day SMA. Carry positions overnight. 5% stop loss.
Short 2 lots of BANKNIFTY on the 5-minute chart when the 9 EMA crosses below the 21 EMA. Target 150 points, stop 75 points. Also exit on the bullish cross.
On the 1-hour NIFTY chart, buy when the close is above the 200 EMA and the MACD (12, 26, 9) histogram crosses above zero. Exit when the histogram crosses below zero. Positional, carry overnight.
Reliance 15-minute, intraday: buy when the close crosses above the 20 EMA and the 20-bar volume ratio is above 2. Exit when the close crosses below the 20 EMA.
BN me 5 min chart pe 9 aur 21 EMA ka bullish crossover aaye to ATM CE lena hai weekly expiry ka, SL 30% premium pe, 3:10 tak exit kar dena.
Nifty 15 min: RSI(14) 70 ke neeche cross kare to short karna hai. RSI 40 ke neeche aa jaye to cover kar do. SL 0.5%.
BNF 5m PDL breakdown: close PDL ke neeche cross kare to ATM PE buy, weekly. SL 25%, TGT 50% premium pe. 1 trade/day.
Roz 9:20 pe Nifty ka ATM straddle sell karna hai, weekly expiry, dono legs pe 25% SL, 3:15 pe square off.
FinNifty 5m: close ST(10,3) ke upar cross kare aur price 20 EMA ke upar ho to long. Close ST ke neeche cross kare to exit.
Banknifty 15m me MACD(12,26,9) bullish crossover pe 1 lot ATM PE sell karo monthly expiry ka, SL 35% premium, ulta crossover aaye to exit.
TCS daily: close 50 DMA ke upar cross kare to kharidna hai, close 50 DMA ke neeche cross kare to bech dena. Positional hai, overnight hold.
Nifty 5m BB(20,2) squeeze: bandwidth 0.005 se kam ho to iron fly, yaani ATM CE aur ATM PE sell, 3 strike OTM CE aur PE buy, weekly expiry. Din me ek hi trade.
Buy when the 9 EMA crosses above the 21 EMA and sell on the opposite cross.

cases.prompt: Scalp Nifty futures using order book imbalance: buy when the bid quantity is 3 times the ask quantity across the top 5 levels.
